recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Do not add Timing.description or Timing.displayName for this issue; revisit only if a later explicit work-group decision changes the Timing.code.text approach.
issue_request: FHIR-20671 was a Published FHIR-core datatypes issue resolved Not Persuasive with Modification. It asked whether Timing needed a description or displayName subelement for text such as "TID, for 14 days"; the approved resolution was to use the existing Timing.code.text guidance and move that guidance, example, and following paragraph before the examples table.

Current source and blame show that application remains present.
additional_context: FHIR-13941 previously resolved a Timing.text request by documenting Timing.code.text rather than adding a new element. FHIR-53411 later removed an inaccurate sentence from the same Timing prose but preserved the Timing.code.text approach. MnM May 2019 WGM minutes corroborate FHIR-20671 as Not Persuasive with Modification, and targeted Zulip/Confluence searches found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The active datatypes source already maps textual timing instructions to Timing.code.text before the examples table, and the Timing spreadsheet defines Timing.code as CodeableConcept with text in code.text available.
